stories.name_fr: Acquisitions stratégiques dans les data centers
stories.explanation: Nombre et portée des acquisitions ciblées pour renforcer la couverture end-to-end du chip au grid dans les data centers hyperscale.
stories.signal: Quatre acquisitions majeures complétées ou annoncées en 2025-2026 (Fibrebond, Resilient, Ultra PCS, Boyd Thermal).
stories.description: Eaton a déployé une stratégie d'acquisition ciblée pour renforcer ses solutions data center: Fibrebond (modular solutions pour data centers hyperscale et multi-tenant), Resilient (technologie de transformateur solid-state), Boyd Thermal (refroidissement liquide chip-to-grid), Ultra PCS (solutions aérospatiales next-generation).
_validation: Verified: 4 acquisitions explicitly mentioned in Business section
Fibrebond: 'expands Eaton's presence in the growing market for modular solutions for multi-tenant and hyperscale data center customers'
Resilient: 'strengthens our power distribution offerings and accelerates the commercialization of solid-state transformer technology'

Boyd Thermal: 'expands Eaton's existing portfolio of solutions for data center customers to include critical liquid cooling technology, enabling the Company to serve hyperscale and colocation customers from the chip to the grid'
Ultra PCS: 'expands and integrates Eaton's offerings in next-generation aerospace solutions' (closed January 23, 2026)

stories.name_fr: Momentum sur les data centers et l'aérospatial
stories.name_en: Data Center and Aerospace Market Momentum
stories.explanation: Positionnement d'Eaton sur les deux principaux drivers de croissance: data centers hyperscale et marché aérospatial defense.
stories.signal: Eaton bénéficie de momentum dans les data centers et d'un cycle de croissance dans l'aérospatial defense.
stories.description: La compagnie est positionée pour bénéficier de megatrends d'électrification, digitalisation, et reindustrialisation, avec momentum particulier dans data centers (post-acquisitions Boyd Thermal, Fibrebond, Resilient) et cycle de croissance en aerospace-defense commercial.
_validation: Verified market momentum statements from Business section
Direct quote: 'benefiting from momentum in the data center and utility end markets'
Direct quote: 'growth cycle in the commercial aerospace and defense markets'
Megatrends confirmed: 'capitalizing on the megatrends of the electrification, digitalization, and the reindustrialization'
Acquisition strategy supports data center focus through chip-to-grid capabilities (Boyd, Fibrebond, Resilient)
